title: The Work-From-Home Job That Charges You to Work
hook: The job was clicking a button. Then the employer asked for crypto.
description: FBI IC3 warning, 4 June 2024: fake work-from-home task jobs may ask applicants to pay cryptocurrency to unlock work while showing earnings that cannot be cashed out. Source: https://www.ic3.gov/PSA/2024/PSA240604 . Recreated visuals are illustrations.

scenes.narration: The job is clicking a button. Then your supposed employer asks you to pay cryptocurrency to keep working.
scenes.heading: THE JOB
scenes.label: Illustration

scenes.narration: The FBI describes fake remote jobs advertised through unsolicited calls or messages, sometimes posing as staffing agencies.
scenes.heading: THE OFFER
scenes.label: Illustration

scenes.narration: Tasks may be framed as rating restaurants or 'optimizing' a service. The work sounds simple and repeatable.
scenes.heading: THE TASK
scenes.label: Illustration

scenes.narration: A dashboard appears to show earnings. But according to the FBI, victims cannot actually cash them out.
scenes.heading: FAKE BALANCE
scenes.label: Illustration

scenes.narration: To unlock more work or earn more, the site demands a crypto payment. That payment goes to the scammer.
scenes.heading: THE PAYMENT
scenes.label: Illustration

scenes.narration: The dashboard creates the feeling of progress. The payment demand reveals who the real customer is.
scenes.heading: THE TURN
scenes.label: Illustration

scenes.narration: Never pay a supposed employer to do a job. Save the messages and transaction details, then report the scheme at IC3.gov.
scenes.heading: THE RULE
scenes.label: Illustration

notes: FBI IC3 PSA dated 4 June 2024 documents unsolicited fake task jobs, restaurant ratings or optimization, crypto payments to unlock work, and fake unwithdrawable earnings.
The scene is an illustrated composite of the documented pattern, not a named victim story.
